points.description: Names stem flow (water running down the stems/branches/trunk) as one way intercepted water reaches the ground.
points.partial_credit: Half if the idea is described vaguely (e.g. water running down the tree) without being clear.

points.description: Names throughfall (water dripping/falling through leaves or canopy to the ground) as the other way.
points.partial_credit: Half if described vaguely (e.g. drips from leaves) without being clear.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stem flow and throughfall in either order, in any wording that clearly gives the idea (water running down trunk/branches; water dripping or falling from leaves/canopy). Give 1 mark if only one is correct, or both are only vaguely given. Give 0 for unrelated answers such as evaporation or infiltration; extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
